description: Prices one trade of a pump.fun coin on every surface PumpFYI tracks (pump.fun app, Terminal, Axiom, GMGN, fomo, Photon, Telegram bots, Phantom, Jupiter), sorted by total fee, with or without each surface's documented referral discount. Surfaces that don't publish their fee are listed separately with the part we can state. Ranking is by cost alone, never by referral payouts.

amount_usd.description: Trade size in USD (optional; default $1,000). Some apps (fomo) charge flat fees on small trades, so size can change the rate.

custom_pair.description: True for a coin paired with an asset other than SOL or USDC (flat 1.25% curve / 0.30% PumpSwap).

market_cap.description: Coin market cap in the quote asset (price x 1 billion tokens). Required for stage "pumpswap".

new_token.description: Coin under 24 hours old, counted from its creation, not its graduation (Jupiter Ultra on jup.ag charges 0.5% then, 0.1% after; checked against jup.ag quotes 11 Nov 2026). Pass it when you know the age: a graduated coin can be hours old and a curve coin can be days old. Default: true on the curve, false after graduation.

quote.description: Asset the coin is paired with (default SOL).

referral.description: Apply each surface's documented referral discount (default true).

stage.description: "curve" (bonding curve, before graduation; default), "pumpswap" (the coin's canonical PumpSwap pool after graduation) or "pumpswap-noncanonical".

name: route_cost
title: Cheapest surface for a pump.fun trade
